caption: The drawing depicts a metallic watering can with a cylindrical body and a domed lid, topped with a rounded finial. The main body and lid of the can are rendered in shades of greenish brass with subtle highlights and shadows, giving a sense of metallic sheen. Attached near the center of the can's body is a thick handle that curves upward and horizontally to the right, and is colored in a matching yellow-green tone. Extending from the front lower portion of the can is a long, gently curving spout that ends in a slightly flared opening with a copper or reddish rim. Mounted at the top-most part of the handle, above the central body, is a vertical rod supporting a wavy, flag-like attachment rendered in shades of dark gray and black. The background is a plain, tan or beige color, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Lamp
